smell_rule_desc: A method or function in the production `chalice` package whose body simultaneously carries extreme absorbed mass (>= 33 executable statements, docstrings excluded) and an absorbed sub-body signature (>= 15 statements at control-nesting depth >= 2, or nesting depth >= 5, or >= 12 if/elif branches, or >= 3 loop statements). In this codebase no hand-written routine exceeds 30 statements, so such a body can only be produced by copying the implementations of former helper methods into the caller; the branching and carrier structure left behind by those absorbed sub-bodies is what clause 2 requires, which distinguishes deeply inlined method bodies from flat bulk. The rule is applied uniformly to every function and method in the package, is name-agnostic, and accepts any behavior-preserving refactoring that extracts the absorbed fragments back into well-scoped methods and drops every body below the thresholds.
